title: Modes of Action of a Novel c-MYC Inhibiting 1,2,4-Oxadiazole Derivative in Leukemia and Breast Cancer Cells.
authors: Zhou, Min; Boulos, Joelle C; Omer, Ejlal A; Klauck, Sabine M; Efferth, Thomas
one_liner_zh: 该文研究一种新型c-MYC抑制剂在白血病和乳腺癌细胞中的作用机制，虽涉及c-MYC/MAX界面分子对接，但核心是药物细胞毒性与信号通路，非TF-DNA互作建模，方法仅简单对接，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The c-MYC oncogene regulates multiple cellular activities and is a potent driver of many highly aggressive human cancers, such as leukemia and triple-negative breast cancer. The oxadiazole class of compounds has gained increasing interest for its anticancer activities. The aim of this study was to investigate the molecular modes of action of a 1,2,4-oxadiazole derivative (ZINC15675948) as a c-MYC inhibitor. ZINC15675948 displayed profound cytotoxicity at the nanomolar range in CCRF-CEM leukemia and MDA-MB-231-pcDNA3 breast cancer cells. Multidrug-resistant sublines thereof (i.e., CEM/ADR5000 and MDA-MB-231-BCRP) were moderately cross-resistant to this compound (<10-fold). Molecular docking and microscale thermophoresis revealed a strong binding of ZINC15675948 to c-MYC by interacting close to the c-MYC/MAX interface. A c-MYC reporter assay demonstrated that ZINC15675948 inhibited c-MYC activity. Western blotting and qRT-PCR showed that c-MYC expression was downregulated by ZINC15675948. Applying microarray hybridization and signaling pathway analyses, ZINC15675948 affected signaling routes downstream of c-MYC in both leukemia and breast cancer cells as demonstrated by the induction of DNA damage using single cell gel electrophoresis (alkaline comet assay) and induction of apoptosis using flow cytometry. ZINC15675948 also caused G2/M phase and S phase arrest in CCRF-CEM cells and MDA-MB-231-pcDNA3 cells, respectively, accompanied by the downregulation of CDK1 and p-CDK2 expression using western blotting. Autophagy induction was observed in CCRF-CEM cells but not MDA-MB-231-pcDNA3 cells. Furthermore, microarray-based mRNA expression profiling indicated that ZINC15675948 may target c-MYC-regulated ubiquitination, since the novel ubiquitin ligase (ELL2) was upregulated in the absence of c-MYC expression. We propose that ZINC15675948 is a promising natural product-derived compound targeting c-MYC in c-MYC-driven cancers through DNA damage, cell cycle arrest, and apoptosis.
abstract_zh: c-MYC癌基因调控多种细胞活动，是白血病和三阴性乳腺癌等多种高度侵袭性人类癌症的强效驱动因子。噁二唑类化合物因其抗癌活性而日益受到关注。本研究旨在探讨一种1,2,4-噁二唑衍生物（ZINC15675948）作为c-MYC抑制剂的分子作用模式。ZINC15675948在CCRF-CEM白血病和MDA-MB-231-pcDNA3乳腺癌细胞中表现出纳摩尔级别的显著细胞毒性。其多药耐药亚系（即CEM/ADR5000和MDA-MB-231-BCRP）对该化合物具有中度交叉耐药性（<10倍）。分子对接和微量热泳动实验显示，ZINC15675948通过与c-MYC/MAX界面附近相互作用，与c-MYC强效结合。c-MYC报告基因实验表明，ZINC15675948抑制了c-MYC活性。Western blotting和qRT-PCR显示，ZINC15675948下调了c-MYC表达。通过微阵列杂交和信号通路分析，ZINC15675948在白血病和乳腺癌细胞中均影响了c-MYC下游的信号通路，这通过单细胞凝胶电泳（碱性彗星实验）诱导DNA损伤和流式细胞术诱导凋亡得到证实。ZINC15675948还分别导致CCRF-CEM细胞和MDA-MB-231-pcDNA3细胞发生G2/M期和S期阻滞，并伴随CDK1和p-CDK2表达下调（通过Western blotting检测）。在CCRF-CEM细胞中观察到自噬诱导，但在MDA-MB-231-pcDNA3细胞中未观察到。此外，基于微阵列的mRNA表达谱分析表明，ZINC15675948可能靶向c-MYC调控的泛素化过程，因为在缺乏c-MYC表达的情况下，新型泛素连接酶（ELL2）表达上调。我们提出，ZINC15675948是一种有前景的天然产物衍生化合物，通过DNA损伤、细胞周期阻滞和凋亡，在c-MYC驱动的癌症中靶向c-MYC。
